# Third-party: relr-other-bins (wave-4 slot 368)

No new dependency, no copied code. Cargo.lock unchanged. Tools used only for the measurement
(not shipped, not committed): rust-lld (ships with the Rust toolchain), zig 0.15.2 cc wrapper
from slot 338 (MIT) for aarch64 SQLite, qemu-aarch64-static for running aarch64 bytes, readelf.
